name: neural-potentiation
description: Synaptic substrate of biological active inference — long-term potentiation/depression (LTP/LTD) writes priors into synaptic weights = the learning landscape (Deep CANALs). A held vascular latch annealed long enough crystallizes into a neuron prior. Use when modeling consolidation, neuron priors, the inference→learning landscape write-path, or commit-to-disk of a held prediction.
